pending: Other domains are not yet semantically registered; the typed whole-tree call/SQL inventory remains discovery evidence, not a verified operation matrix.
These records describe baseline callbacks/current symbols and planned case links; leaf cases are not yet implemented and must not be reported as PASS.
Saves digest lock acquire/release definitions are absent, intentionally null; the required coordination schema must reject these records until RF03/RF04/RF08/RF18 implement them.
Existing failure-injection tests cover selected late failures only. Add independent assertions after every listed write stage and for each guard at RF08.

Identity records now cover 15 current actions, including implicit session refresh and rate-limit clear. Register separate per-operation fault tests before treating planned RF07 aggregate links as coverage.

RF07 source review found administrator request authority is checked by HTTP before privileged account/link callbacks, while those callbacks re-read the target but not the actor/session. Reproduce expiration/revocation races and implement transaction-time actor checks.

Account link issuance creates link/audit identities inside upper callbacks; move preparation and random effects out of transactions during RF04/RF07. Pure policy registry deliberately excludes bootstrapPlan, Authentication.verify, recheckReset and Limiter.record because these perform I/O or random work.

Snapshot entries are existing read definitions or Model input/view definitions when the baseline mutation has no independent snapshot read; the fresh_facts record states the actual conditional SQL behavior.
